crossRefs.note: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there…
But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even…

translations.web: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.
translations.bsb: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. Then we will not be boasting in the work already done in another man’s territory.
translations.kjv: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.
translations.asv: so as to preach the gospel even unto the parts beyond you, and not to glory in another's province in regard of things ready to our hand.
